title: OpenPipeStress Rule-Check Run Result
description: Strict JSON syntax schema for the rule_check_runner result: per-check outcomes plus a worst-of aggregate over all of a rule pack's check_definitions. Published by piping DEL-10-03 as the standalone result-schema declaration cited by the tier-0 profile's deterministic_check_result_schema hook. Derived field-by-field from the Rust source of truth core/rules/rule_check_runner/src/lib.rs (DOCUMENT_KIND :74, PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_NOTICE :78-80, RuleCheckStatus :141-150, ComputedQuantity :171-177, BoundInput :179-193, RunFinding :195-202, CheckOutcome :204-223, RuleCheckRunResult :225-232, run_rule_checks :235); on any disagreement the Rust source governs. Software rule-check evidence only; not a professional, certification, sealing, authentication, approval, or code-compliance claim — human review remains required. The wider status vocabulary (MODEL_INCOMPLETE, MECHANICS_SOLVED, HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED) and the external HUMAN_APPROVED_FOR_PROJECT record are intentionally not producible here.

rule_pack_id.description: Echoed from the rule pack's /metadata/rule_pack_id; empty string when absent (lib.rs:238-242).

grammar_version.description: Echoed from the rule pack's /grammar_version; empty string when absent (lib.rs:243-247).

aggregate_status.description: Worst-of precedence across all checks: USER_RULE_FAILED > RULE_INPUTS_INCOMPLETE > USER_RULE_CHECKED (lib.rs:160-168).

professional_boundary_notice.const: Software rule-check evidence only; not a professional, certification, sealing, authentication, approval, or code-compliance claim. Human review remains required.
professional_boundary_notice.description: PROFESSIONAL_BOUNDARY_NOTICE (lib.rs:78-80); carried on every run result.

RuleCheckStatus.description: The three automatic rule-check statuses this runner may emit (lib.rs:141-150).

dimension.description: snake_case dimension token (e.g. "dimensionless", "stress"); vocabulary owned by schemas/units.schema.yaml DimensionId.

ComputedQuantity.description: A computed or limit quantity surfaced in a check outcome (lib.rs:171-177).

source_kind.description: Echoes the rule pack's required_inputs source_kind (e.g. solver_result, user_supplied_rule_value, private_library_value); vocabulary owned by schemas/rule_pack.schema.yaml.

note.description: Provenance note; for private_library_value inputs the library/record/slot identifiers are carried here — the value itself stays in the private library (IP boundary).

BoundInput.description: What a single rule-pack input resolved to; value/unit/result_id/note are omitted when absent (serde skip_serializing_if; lib.rs:179-193).

severity.description: Open string in the Rust type; emitted vocabulary at publication is "blocking".

RunFinding.description: A finding from completeness or evaluation, traced to its engine (lib.rs:195-202).

acceptability_relation.description: The relation that governed the result: one of the four ordering relations for a quantity-vs-limit check (default less_than_or_equal when absent from the pack), formula_predicate for a boolean formula, or none when blocked before acceptability (lib.rs:210-217).

CheckOutcome.description: The outcome of one check_definition; computed_value/limit_value are omitted when absent (serde skip_serializing_if; lib.rs:204-223).
